llms.text:
# Nomu

> Nomu makes merch for consumer brands. You write a brief, our agents put it in front of several manufacturers at once and come back with quotes to compare; from there we run sourcing, sampling, production, quality control at the factory, warehousing, fulfillment, cross-border and sales tax, with an adaptive storefront on top. There is no minimum order, and the software is free: we earn on the orders we run, not on a licence.

Nomu Labs is the entity behind Nomu. The product targets DTC and consumer brands that want a single operator-grade platform instead of stitching Shopify + 3PLs + sourcing agents + customs brokers. Storefronts are agentic-commerce ready (LLM-driven shopping surfaces, programmatic checkout). The team operates on Solana for on-chain commerce drops in addition to standard payment rails.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://nomu.store/): Hero pitch, social proof, "grow your brand" overview, sourcing demo, QC demo, cross-border demo, storefront demo, supply chain software, FAQ, closing CTA.
- [Sitemap](https://nomu.store/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of public pages.
- [Robots policy](https://nomu.store/robots.txt): Crawler directives.

## Product surface (sections on the homepage)

- **Hero** - Brand pitch "Your merch, in production in 5 minutes." with a live falling-chip stack showing the operator graph.
- **Social proof** — Brands and partners running on Nomu.
- **Grow your brand** — Adaptive storefront pillar: agentic commerce, conversion-tuned surfaces.
- **Sourcing demo** — Chat between a brand and the Nomu sourcing agent (Jean-Claude) for factory discovery and sample requests.
- **QC demo** — Local sample/batch inspection by Nomu Ops (Luke) — no international shipping downtime between rounds.
- **Cross-border demo** — Customs + duties + multi-region routing handled inside the platform.
- **Storefront demo** — Adaptive storefront preview (desktop + mobile).
- **Supply chain software** — Sourcing, manufacturing, warehousing, fulfillment surfaced as one operator console.
- **FAQ** — Answers to onboarding, pricing model, integrations, payment rails (incl. Solana), white-glove scope.
- **Closing CTA** — Book a demo entry point.

## Legal

- [Website Terms of Use](https://nomu.store/website-terms-of-use): Terms for using nomu.store.
- [Privacy Notice](https://nomu.store/privacy-notice): Data collection, processing, and user rights.
- [Marketplace Terms of Use](https://nomu.store/marketplace-terms-of-use): Terms for Nomu commerce drops.
- [InvisibleStaking Terms of Use](https://nomu.store/invisible-staking-terms-of-use): Terms governing the Nomu InvisibleStaking program.
- [OG NFT Terms and Conditions](https://nomu.store/og-nft-terms-and-conditions): Terms for the OG NFT holder program.

## Social

- [Twitter / X](https://twitter.com/NomuStores): Product updates, drop announcements.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nomu-labs/): Company updates, hiring.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/NomuDev): Open-source repo
